name: settings-shell
title: Settings shell
description: A settings layout: grouped side navigation, a page title and a focused content column, with the nav becoming a scrolling tab row on phones.
docs: Pass groups (labelled lists of links, the SidebarNav shape) with currentHref, plus title, description and actions for the page. backHref adds a Back to app link. The children are the sections of the page: they are stacked with one gap in a column of at most 42rem. From md the navigation sticks under the top of the viewport; on a phone the groups become a row of links that scrolls sideways with faded edges and the current page is scrolled into view. Pass linkAs for your router link.
